item.subject: science
item.chapter_label: Earth, Sun and the apparent motion of the sky
item.stem: During a solar eclipse, Meera's teacher takes the class outside to observe the event. Which statement about watching the eclipse safely is correct?

options.A: It is unsafe to look directly at the Sun during a solar eclipse without proper protection, so Meera should use a pinhole projector or certified eclipse-viewing glasses.
options.B: It is safe to watch the eclipse by looking at the Sun's reflection in a steel plate or a hand mirror.
options.C: It is safe to look directly at the Sun during the eclipse as long as Meera wears ordinary dark sunglasses.
options.D: When only a thin crescent of the Sun remains visible, it is safe for Meera to look at it directly without any protection.
